facts.claim: Legal name EUROSICMA - COSTRUZIONI MACCHINE AUTOMATICHE S.P.A. (short form EUROSICMA S.P.A.), Partita IVA / Codice Fiscale 00730100153, REA MI-606927.
Operational plant at Via Michelangelo Buonarroti 4/6, 20090 Segrate (MI); legal registered office at Via Fratelli Gabba 6, 20121 Milano.
Share capital EUR 1,000,000.00 fully paid up.
Founded in 1965 by the Redaelli family; corporate registration dates back to November 1962.
ATECO 28.29.30: Manufacture of machinery for dosing, packaging and wrapping (confezionatrici orizzontali flow-pack e piega).

any: dosatura, la confezione e per l'imballaggio

Controlled subsidiary of I.M.A. Industria Macchine Automatiche S.p.A. (IMA S.p.A., Bologna).

facts.claim: IMA acquired 60% of Eurosicma on 25 July 2017 for EUR 25.8M (EV ~EUR 43.5M) with put/call options on the remaining 40%.
Ultimate controlling shareholder chain: SO.FI.M.A. S.p.A. (Vacchi family) and BDT & MSD Partners through Alps Holding.

facts.claim: 1965 founding by the Redaelli family in Milan developing specialized flow-wrapping systems for candies and bakeries.
July 2017 deal closing: IMA buys 60% stake in Eurosicma expanding horizontal packaging market share.
Integrated into IMA Confectionery and Horizontal Packaging solutions portfolio.
Latest AIDA accounts: revenue EUR 16.1M (16,074k EUR), 94 employees.

facts.claim: At the 2017 transaction closing Eurosicma registered revenue ~EUR 27M, EBITDA EUR 4.5M, and positive net cash EUR 7M.
Historical founding leadership: Gianpaolo Redaelli and the Redaelli family.

facts.claim: Horizontal Form Fill Seal (HFFS) flow-pack machines for bakery, confectionery, noodles, and crackers.
Fold wrapping machines for candies, toffees, bouillon cubes, chewing gum (envelope fold, bunch, double twist).
High-speed multi-lane automatic feeding, buffering, and product orientation lines.
Packaging systems for medical and personal care goods (plaster strips, cosmetic cotton pads, healthcare products).
Certified according to ISO 9001:2015 quality management standards.
Manufactured to European CE machinery directives and hygienic food-grade sanitary standards (GMP compliance).
Main production and engineering hub located at Via Michelangelo Buonarroti 4/6, 20090 Segrate (Milano).
Registered office at Via Fratelli Gabba 6, 20121 Milano.
Supported by IMA Group global commercial and technical service network across over 80 countries.
Member of UCIMA (Unione Costruttori Italiani Macchine Automatiche per il Confezionamento e l'Imballaggio).
Regular exhibitor at Interpack (Düsseldorf), Ipack-Ima (Milano), and ProSweets (Cologne).
Brand site eurosicma.it cross-linked and integrated into the global IMA Group portal (imagroup.com).
Publishes technical catalogs and brochures for flow-wrapping machines, candy wrapping systems, and automatic feeders.
